reader.requirement: All level-01 records under one FD, SD or CD share one storage area, so each is an implicit redefinition of the others whatever their lengths, layout (including OCCURS DEPENDING ON) and the file's organization, while RD entries are excluded; the witness covers two fixed records of one sequential FD.

edition-consulted.switches: the COMMUNICATION SECTION (the CD arm of this rule) is accepted at 85 and 2002 and refused from 2014 (COBOL0902)

reader.edition-search: grep of DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry in FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs: the three reads (lines 289, 406, 428) are RECORD CONTAINS rules, not the record-area link; LinkImplicitRecordArea and CommunicationSectionBinder.BindEntry's link loop read no edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the CD level indicator exists only at 85 and 2002; the FD and SD arms are the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: SD, CD, indexed and relative files, a RECORD VARYING file with records of different lengths, and an ODO record are not exercised

reader.notes: One linker serves the FD and SD arms and the CD binder links its records with its own loop. Records left unlinked are dynamic-length or pointer-class ones, and 1985 has neither. A record with OCCURS DEPENDING ON is linked, as the probe shows.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-105/src/g3cd.cob at --std 85 (g3cd-001) tests the CD arms the reader did not run, two 01 records each under CD FOR OUTPUT and CD FOR I-O (formats 2 and 3, which 85 has and 2014+ dropped). It printed OB=ABC OC=DEF and XB=GHIJ XC=KLMN. Under CD FOR INPUT with SYMBOLIC QUEUE IS QN (defined by the CD), the records share the area with each other and with the CD's own field: IB=QUEUE1 IC=QUEUE2 QN=QUEUE1QUEUE2, and after MOVE to QN, IA=ZZZ. g6a: two 01 under an EXTERNAL FD share one area. Grep of Dialect|Edition in FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs: the DialectLevel reads at lines 289, 406 and 428 are RECORD/BLOCK CONTAINS rules, not the linker. The RD exclusion has nothing a program can observe (report groups are not MOVE targets), so it was not probed. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR3; OK §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR9; OK §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR14.
